facts.fact: The ministry says national consultations on 1-2 July 2026 and a validation workshop on 21-22 September 2026 on the National Blueprint on Data Valorisation involved ministries, universities, companies, civil society and partners.
The ministry says Senegal is a pilot country with Kenya and Lesotho in Smart Africa's Data Governance in Africa programme, under way since June 2026.
